fields.label: Micron is required to comply with federal reporting regulations regarding those who seek employment with the company.  We need to know whether you are a U.S. worker. A U.S. worker is defined by the U.S. Department of Labor as a 1) U.S. citizen, 2) U.S. national, 3) U.S. legal permanent resident, 4) refugee, or 5) person granted asylum. Are you in one of the above five groups?
